Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا
Translation: All praise is for Allah, who has not taken a son

Arabic text: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِيْ الْمُلْكِ
Translation: And has no partner in [His] dominion

Arabic text: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ الذُّلِّ
Translation: And has no protector out of weakness
And magnify Him with all magnificence
O Allah, I ask You by the strongholds of Your might
Upon the pillars of Your throne
And by the utmost of mercy from Your Book
And by Your Name, the Greatest, the Greatest, the Greatest
And by Your Remembrance, the Highest, the Highest, the Highest

Arabic text: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: To send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَأَنْ تَفْعَلَ بِىْ مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ
Translation: And to do with me what is worthy of You
